title: Vegetation in Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Overlay the vegetation map on the climate map; the child sees vegetation follow rainfall.

skills.key_step: The child gives the factors of vegetation, describes and locates Africa's vegetation regions, and picks ways to conserve them.

floor.prerequisite: Names vegetation types of Eastern Africa.
floor.question: What vegetation covers the Maasai Mara?

board.say: What vegetation grows here, and why?

misconceptions.ask: Which vegetation grows in the Congo basin?
misconceptions.repair: Link rainfall with the thickness of the trees.
Ask what plants need to grow.
Ask what happens to the soil when a forest is cut.

misconceptions.ask: Where is Mediterranean vegetation found in Africa?
misconceptions.repair: Shade the two Mediterranean areas on the map.

checks.question: Which vegetation grows in the Congo basin?
Give one method of conserving vegetation.
checks.answer: any of: planting trees, protecting forests, controlled grazing, energy-saving jikos
